entries.name: Poly Haven terrain PBR atlas
entries.relationship: CC0 source of photographic grass, soil, exposed-rock, and damp-shore terrain materials for the desktop vertical slice.
entries.usage: Guarded desktop and low-memory WebP atlases provide albedo, OpenGL tangent-space normal, and roughness channels in grass, soil, rock, and shore slots.
entries.modifications: Selected only official 1K JPEG diffuse, OpenGL normal, and roughness maps; verified upstream MD5 and local SHA-256; resized tiles for proportional copied-edge gutters that protect bilinear sampling through at least mip level 6; packed four horizontal material slots; converted roughness to grayscale RGB; and encoded browser-native desktop and low-memory WebP atlases with Sharp 0.35.3.
entries.notes: The official Poly Haven asset pages and license page declare all four sources CC0. The exact asset pages, artists, physical dimensions, upstream URLs, source byte counts and hashes, atlas layout, output hashes, and conversion settings are preserved in terrain-atlas.json. Source JPEGs, archives, AO, displacement, metalness, previews, and terrain-source HDRIs are not redistributed as part of this atlas.

entries.name: Poly Haven modular-home architecture detail atlas

High-quality Walk samples only the high normal and roughness atlases; Orbit and low quality keep the authored materials without additional texture reads.
entries.modifications: Selected only official 1K JPEG diffuse, OpenGL normal, and roughness maps; verified upstream MD5 and local SHA-256; resized tiles for proportional copied-edge gutters; packed four exact material-family slots; converted roughness to grayscale RGB; and encoded deterministic browser-native high and low WebP atlases with Sharp 0.35.3. The additive runtime preserves the authored base material and samples only mean-centered normal and roughness detail in high-quality Walk.

entries.name: Repo Magical Kingdom Four-Season Cycle brand mark
entries.relationship: Original generated project identity selected for the in-application brand and installable app icons.
entries.usage: Application HUD, loading and renderer-fallback brand mark; Apple touch icon; and 192/512-pixel installable web-app icons.
entries.modifications: The previously selected Seasonal Gateway mark was edited with OpenAI image generation to remove the central crystal and dark tile, enlarge the four-season ring, and place it on a controlled chroma background. The chroma background was removed locally to true alpha, then the approved transparent master was resized to 256, 192, and 512 pixels with macOS sips. A 180-pixel Apple touch icon was resized from the approved transparent 256-pixel mark without generative alteration. The manifest derivatives were renamed from generic app-icon filenames to content-specific Four-Season Cycle filenames so existing installations do not retain the superseded mark from browser caches.

generatedMediaProvenance.prompt:
Use case: precise brand-mark edit and background extraction.

Input Image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the same polished, sculpted, modern four-season visual language and the same four seasonal lobes: spring blush pink petals with a cherry blossom; summer fresh green leaves with a small leaf sprout; autumn warm amber-orange foliage with a maple leaf; winter icy pale blue with a snowflake.

Required changes: remove the entire vertical diamond, gem, and compass object from the center, including its glow and every remnant; leave a clean open circular negative-space center and do not replace the diamond with any icon, letter, jewel, portal, star, or object; remove the navy rounded-square tile and all environmental background; make the four-season circular ring itself larger and bolder, occupying roughly 90 percent of the square canvas with even padding; keep the four lobes connected in a smooth circular cycle and make each seasonal symbol legible around 48 pixels; preserve dimensional beveled material and soft highlights on the mark itself without a cast shadow outside the mark; place the isolated mark on a perfectly flat uniform #7F00FF chroma-key background without violet or purple in the mark. No text, border, watermark, or extra objects.
negativeConstraints: No words, letters, code symbols, GitHub logo, or literal crown
No buildings, trees, mountains, stars, thin lines, or micro-detail
No watermark, franchise imagery, or copied third-party artwork

referenceAssets.description: The project's previously approved Seasonal Gateway application mark used as the sole edit target.
referenceAssets.rights: Original Repo Magical Kingdom generated application artwork controlled by Parris Digital and already registered in this attribution registry.

humanEdits: Reviewed the edited ring at full resolution and at 64 pixels for symbol recognition, clean negative space, and absence of the removed crystal.
Removed the controlled chroma background locally with a soft alpha matte, two-pixel edge contraction, and spill cleanup; no subject pixels were painted or composited.
conversionSteps: Removed the generated #7F00FF chroma field from the 1254 × 1254 source with the project ImageGen skill's remove_chroma_key.py helper.
Resized the approved transparent master to 256 × 256 for the HUD brand mark and 192 × 192 and 512 × 512 for the web app manifest with macOS sips.
Resized the approved transparent 256 × 256 HUD derivative to 180 × 180 for the Next.js Apple touch icon with macOS sips.
Renamed the 192 × 192 and 512 × 512 manifest derivatives to content-specific Four-Season Cycle filenames to invalidate stale platform-icon URLs without changing their pixels.

review.notes: The only supplied image was the project's own registered prior application mark. The revised mark contains no center crystal, readable text, third-party logo, character, franchise imagery, or Tencent/WorldClaw media.

generatedMediaProvenance.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: panoramic GitHub README hero banner for the open-source project Repo Magical Kingdom

Input images:
- Image 1 is a reference for the product's real repository-universe system: realistic terrestrial, rocky, and ringed gas-giant planets floating in a deep living star field.
- Image 2 is a reference for the product's enterable repository kingdom: clean isometric terrain, continuous mountains, river and lake, settlements, forests, and seasonal appearance.
Use both only as references to this project's own visual language. Create a newly composed hero illustration, not a screenshot collage or pixel copy.

Primary request: portray the complete semantic journey from a GitHub profile's planetary repository universe into one living, explorable repository kingdom.

Scene/backdrop: one cohesive cinematic panorama. The left third contains a refined deep-space repository system with a luminous Earth-like terrestrial planet and an elegant Saturn-like ringed gas giant, realistic spherical materials, atmospheres, cloud bands, moons, orbital arcs, and restrained stars. No buildings or trees attached to any planet. A subtle ribbon of starlight and a crystalline gateway lead toward the right two-thirds, where one large continuous floating kingdom rises in clean isometric perspective: a dominant mountain escarpment, branching river, broad foreground lake, three inhabited medieval hamlets connected by winding paths, layered forests, rocks, tiny wildlife, smoke, and restrained magical motes. Include subtle localized hints of spring blossom, lush summer green, amber autumn, and snow-covered winter as appearance possibilities around the outer landscape, while keeping the kingdom coherent rather than split into quadrants.

Semantic motif: the profile is a planetary universe, each planet is a repository, and entering a planet reveals its repository-derived kingdom. Express this only through composition, orbital relationships, gateway, branching paths, and settlement hierarchy.

Style/medium: premium modern stylized 3D game-world render, physically plausible but softly art-directed PBR, clean contemporary assets, handcrafted modular detail, polished open-source showcase quality.

Composition/framing: extremely wide 2.4:1 banner. Keep the full planetary silhouettes and full kingdom terrain inside safe margins. Kingdom fills roughly 60% of the banner; planets fill roughly 25%; the center transition stays open and readable. Strong thumbnail silhouette, no UI chrome.

Lighting/mood: cinematic transition from deep indigo space on the left to luminous ivory daylight over the kingdom on the right; warm soft shadows, atmospheric depth, magical but grounded, alive.

Color palette: midnight navy and restrained violet stars; ocean blue, cloud white and living green on the terrestrial planet; warm gold and umber on the ringed gas giant; ivory, sage, blush pink, amber foliage, winter blue-white, warm sandstone, and clear turquoise water in the kingdom.

Constraints: no words, letters, source code, logos, badges, watermark, UI panels, fake interface chrome, or legible symbols. No toy planets, no King Kai or Dragon Ball imagery, no houses/trees mounted on spheres, no city skyline, no skyscrapers, no square district pads, no grid layout, no isolated terrain circles, no recognizable franchise characters or protected third-party artwork, and no Tencent/WorldClaw media.
negativeConstraints: No words, letters, source code, logos, badges, watermark, UI panels, or fake interface chrome
No toy planets, franchise imagery, or buildings and trees mounted on spheres
No city skyline, skyscrapers, square district pads, grid layout, or isolated terrain circles
No copied third-party artwork, Tencent or WorldClaw media, or recognizable franchise characters
